_comment: TEST-PRECON pipeline output schema v5. Adds session_placeholders, command_patterns, test_skeleton[].case_outline[] for TEST-PREP v3. Exploration depth: docs/exploration-depth-ladder.json. Pair with <KEY>-precon.md.

format_norms.jira_wiki:
# Pre-Condition Jira wiki format (Corner QA)

Same as v3; exploration depth is agent-only in exploration_log (depth_level, view_id). Phase 4 must produce precon_drill rows before steps claim exploration provenance.

optional_jira_audit.note: Greenfield: existing CRTQA Pre-Conditions are not structural input.

sources._topology_loaded: true when ref/coverage/discover topology fields consumed in Phase 1.
sources._principal_loaded: true when ref downstream_hints provision/personas or discover ref_principal_provision consumed (Round 2 step 6).

principal_provenance._comment: Optional when principal_loaded; documents upstream principal slice ids — no secrets.

session_placeholders._provision_tokens: when needs_dual_account_contrast: group_key_enrg, group_key_oppt; persona routing tokens from ref downstream_hints.personas when cluster surfaces require

ladder_step: execution trade orderkey=<orderkey> orderstatus=COMPLETED price=<price> qty=<qty> transactiontime=now

watchlist_tier_by_qty: Observe Watchlist bid/ask for default order qty; compare to TextConfiguration tier closest >= qty
position_first_tier_quote: Observe Position Book bid/ask from first tier Quote stream only
console_show_prices_first_tier: verify bid/ask from first TextConfiguration tier

case_outline.title: Short scenario title
case_outline._pattern_ref_topology: Must reference key in command_patterns; map discover oracle_binding.oracle_rule via docs/precon-topology-contract.json oracle_rule_to_pattern_ref when topology loaded
